g.text: Press E to edit intentions. Try: 'Fix the login error' and 'Add a regression
Ctrl+B adds a task. Enter continues a checklist. F2 checks or unchecks the
current task. Escape returns to timer shortcuts. Drafts save automatically,
Keep the generated session name or type a unique name before starting.
Unchecked tasks and notes carry forward; completed tasks stay in that block's
history. The session name continues across blocks and breaks. Ctrl+N
Activity off · B focus branches / scope
LEFT / RIGHT steps · TAB buttons · ESC close · scroll for more
